newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Floods kill five in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Floods kill five in Morocco.

text.p: Floods in Morocco have killed five people since Friday, the interior ministry said on Tuesday.
A 12-year-old girl in the northern town of Al Hoceima was swept away by floodwaters. Three people died near Casablanca and a woman was electrocuted in the coastal city of Safi.
At least 25 people died and thousands were made homeless last winter following steady downpours.
